svg.title: From pull request to production
svg.desc:
From pull request to production States shown: Live, Being built, In trial, Planned. Solid lines: data flows today. This quarter: 1. Cache every build (Build); 2. Scan every image (Checks); 3. Release to 5% first (Release).
Blocks, left to right: - Code: Pull request; Code review. Owner: Every team - Build [step 1]: Compile; Unit tests; Container image; Build cache (being built). Owner: Build team - Checks [step 2]: Integration tests; Security scan (being built); Load test (planned). Owner: Quality team - Release [step 3]: Staging; Canary, 5% of users (in trial); Production. Owner: Platform team Lines: - Code -> Build - Build -> Checks - Checks -> Release - Release -> Code, labeled "If errors rise: roll back and tell the author"

path.title: If errors rise: roll back and tell the author
